name: Habits
summary: Tick off daily habits and watch the streaks build across the week.
description:
Add the habits you want to keep, then tick each day you do them. Every habit shows its recent days and current streak, so a gap is easy to spot; widen the widget to see up to three weeks. Hover a habit for its best streak and how often you kept it in the last 30 days, or click it to rename.

Everything stays in this widget; nothing is shared.
